name: Now Playing styleguide
about: Where the design authority for the Now Playing suite lives, what is generated from it, and how to check it. Read this before changing any UI or UX.

tokens.owns: Documented values: colour, type, space, size, shadow, motion, page skin.

stylesheets.owns: The custom properties every product reads (light scheme on :root, dark and touch layers after it). Mirrors tokens.json by hand; see tokenMap.

tokenMap.owns: Which custom property carries each token, and recorded exceptions.

overrides.owns: Temporary cross-product trials written by the styleguide's token editor. Empty in the repository.

components.owns: Every shared control, shell, overlay and state. Imported by the player, the hub admin GUI and the Windows companion.

rules.owns: Interaction and content rules with stable IDs, their owning code and their tests.

coverage.owns: Every surface, state and journey, with discovery sources.

decisions.owns: Adopted, proposed and unresolved decisions and exceptions (DEC-###).

prose.owns: The reasoning behind the visuals, in long form.

conformance.owns: Spec §17/§18 MUSTs mapped to tests, reviewer checks or deviations.

commands.styleguide:build: pnpm styleguide:build — rebuilds docs/design/styleguide.html from the sources above (same as pnpm build:styleguide).
commands.styleguide:check: pnpm styleguide:check — sources and evidence exist, rule IDs are unique, every discovered screen is in the ledger, tokens.json matches the stylesheets, and the committed HTML was built from the current sources.
commands.styleguide:pdf: pnpm styleguide:pdf — prints the committed HTML to docs/design/styleguide.pdf with Playwright's Chromium (set NP_STYLEGUIDE_BROWSER to use another Chromium).
commands.e2e: pnpm --filter @now-playing/aqua-ui test:e2e — measures every mockup at every size.

verification.note: Filled in by whoever last verified the guide at runtime. Source checks are automatic (styleguide:check); these entries record what was seen in a running product.

runtime.scenario: Player dev server, empty library, no hub: each section, Settings, search with no match, the Shared segment (toast by pointer and keyboard), and one token change (--np-accent) seen in the player and the rebuilt guide, then reverted.
runtime.method: Claude browser pane with DOM measurement

runtime.scenario: Hub admin dev server against a fresh data folder: the first-run sign-in screen. Signing in was not attempted; it needs a person to enter the password.

blocked.companion: Electron-only; its renderer needs the preload bridge. Covered by DOM tests and the mockups.
blocked.android: No Android SDK or JDK 17 on the machine that built this revision.
blocked.discord: Needs a bot token and a Discord server; covered by the voice and parity tests.
blocked.local-helper: Console output was not captured for this revision; covered by its integration tests.
